title: John Mack's Harvard study of alien abductions, encouraged by Thomas Kuhn
summary: Jesse Michels tells of John Mack's Harvard study of alien abductions, encouraged by Thomas Kuhn, about 1990s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
